training_source: Public SER head trained on nine named corpora including JL-Corpus and Emozionalmente; Whisper-v3 pretraining incompletely disclosed; author nEMO threshold calibration is counted as seen development use, although its thresholds are not applied here
notes: Each clip (at most 30 s) becomes Whisper-large-v3 log-mel features padded to 30 s; the encoder layers are averaged over the clip's own frames only (50 per second), as in the official melati_emotion.py. Precision: float16 encoder, float32 head.

The prediction is the most probable of the raw probabilities. The official thresholds (melati_emotion.py, label()) are not applied: they were set for precise tagging of podcasts, would turn most clips into neutral, and never return disgusted.

columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the label of each utterance (`Emotion` in `test_sent_emo.csv`): the majority of three annotators who watched the video and read the transcript; the speakers were not asked to act an emotion
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 7 emotions evaluated (angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, sad, surprised)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 7 model classes
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 7 classes (they add up to 1)
